description: This file defines the EmployeeSavedEvent class within the OrangeHRM PIM plugin, handling events related to employee data saving, including a private Employee property, constructor, and getter method.

classes.name: EmployeeSavedEvent
classes.description: An event class representing the saving of an Employee entity, extending the base Event class, encapsulating an Employee object.

methods.description: Returns the Employee object associated with this event.
